owner_authorization.quote: 把你刚刚讲的方案全部做一遍
owner_authorization.interpretation: Implement the complete causal repair, rebuild, and audit. This does not authorize holdout access, model training, promotion, deployment, threshold changes, barrier changes, or live-money operations.

question: Can the 2026-08-30 5-minute MA-launch proposal pool be rebuilt so every model-visible pixel stops at the close-entry decision bar, every label starts on the following bar, and every split/evaluation unit is one event?
claim_boundary: This is a non-directional data-contract audit. Passing proves internal causality and lineage only; it does not prove L1 shape correctness, detector skill, or economic edge.

owner_approved_repair_bundle.reason: The timing boundary, repeated-view unit, split isolation, and evaluator entry semantics are coupled parts of one invalid data contract; testing them independently would preserve a known-invalid pipeline.
changes: visible_end_i becomes core_end_i + 2 and equals decision_i
entry uses decision_i close; outcome resolution begins at decision_i + 1
eight rendered views become one image per event_id
evaluation and bootstrap change from image rows to event_id
train/val use a frozen time cutoff and 450-bar purge
outcome labels are declared L2/diagnostic and cannot become L1 Gold

success_criteria.null_control: Permute outcome kinds across event_ids 1000 times while preserving class balance; the actual deterministic linkage must exceed every shuffled linkage.

stop_conditions: Any audit blocker keeps the artifact rejected and ineligible.
Any need to read a bar at or after holdout_start stops execution and requires new owner approval.
No model training starts from this authorization.
Owner shape adjudication remains mandatory before any L1 Gold release.
historical_artifacts_policy: Do not modify or delete datasets/ma_launch_5m_outcome_v1, datasets/ma_launch_5m_outcome_x8_v1, or their weights/results.
